item: Row 419: the case-insensitive place scan finds its candidates in one prefilter pass
summary: extract_locations ran each of the ~160 case-insensitive \b literal \b patterns (span guards, country names) over the whole article. _scan_prefilter compiles ONE alternation of their distinct leading word runs with the patterns' own flags, finds every position where any of them can start in one pass, and confirms each pattern with its own rx.match there, keeping finditer's per-pattern non-overlap rule; anything outside that argument keeps finditer. The candidate list is identical to the per-pattern loop, pinned over the whole pattern table in six cases and ten surroundings, case folds re and lower() disagree on, the twelve golden fixtures and 400 seeded random texts (a mutant without the flags fails 2,547 of those checks). Measured on the mixed 12-language corpus: 8.07 to 1.67 ms per article for the scan and 8.26 to 1.87 for the whole extract_locations, identical candidates on all 720 texts; the head regex is a zero-width lookahead with no trailing boundary, after an independent read showed a fold from a word character to a non-word one (Greek iota and U+0345) would have hidden a candidate for a name whose first word ends in iota (none in today's table, pinned by a test). www pin kept with --same (the kw engine digest does not cover this file).
